goal: Risk acceptance review: formal acceptance of a finding with the reason, the owner and the review date.
use: Risk acceptance review: formal acceptance of a finding with the reason, the owner and the review date. Use when a finding will not be fixed in the agreed time.

steps.note: List the accepted risks with their findings.
Check the reason. Each acceptance states why fixing is not possible now.
Check the approver. The approver has the authority for the risk level.
Check the review date. Each acceptance has a date to revisit it.
Report. The accepted risks, their approvers and those due for review.
